steps.content: ...Awake?
This is a closed space, like the inside of a container. The shaking beneath your feet signifies you're moving—this is probably the Legion's truck.
A small bump like that put you to sleep for three hours. Looks like the Bureau didn't give you enough training.

options: This is a rather violent invitation.

steps.content: Haha, haven't you memorized the MBCC's most wanted list, Chief?
You call them your teammates? Doesn't the MBCC always treat Sinners as <color=#fb9259>criminals</color>?
Doesn't suit your title? The new chief of the MBCC?
She knows who you are! You startle and finally make out the face of the dark figure before you.

I'm <color=#fb9259>Zoya</color>, the Legion's commander.
In your terms, I'm the <color=#fb9259>boss</color> of a violent Syndicate gang.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: The Sinner you're hunting down is one of <color=#fb9259>my guys</color>.
Calm down. If she really plans to kill you, she'd have already done it. The fact that you're still alive means this person wants something else.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Hmm... You're quite calm.

options: Waiting 3 hours for me to wake up, you must have something to say.

steps.content: She smiles, but there's no warmth in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: First of all, end your chase.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: No matter from whom and why you've accepted this mission, it's coming to an end.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: If you can't end it, I will.
She moves her hand to the chair's armrest and squeezes it, crushing the corner of the strong and firm metal piece like plaster, clearly expressing the message, "I'll end you."
Your head throbs. Sitting before you is the head of the most notorious gang in the entire Syndicate, a Sinner so strong that even Ted fears. Destruction and sabotage are her instincts.
You calm yourself. Staring into her eyes, you ask her:

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>You</color>.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: The Mania has been spreading in Syndicate for so long and the authorities have done nothing. This time around, they're going so far as to violate the Management Regulations they've signed on just to intervene...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: And they've sent you on such an important mission. A new Chief whose background is entirely unknown.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You've led several Sinners to wreck both Ted and SALVA within a day, and even survived that kind of contamination...
She stands up and stamps on the cold chair with one foot.
She leans over and gazes at you with contemptuous eyes, the shadow she casts blocking your sight.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I'm curious what kind of lapdog the authorities have gotten for themselves this time, and how they plan to use you.

options: I'm not really special. I rely on Sinners.
You should ask them, not me

steps.content: Calm down. You stare into her eyes. You see no way out of here, you must pick a way to fight.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Your shackles are an absolute restraint to Sinners, which means you are their worst enemy.
This woman is a Sinner. Even if she's as strong as a monster, she'll still submit to the shackles. Face her, get closer, and even closer...
This is the best and the final chance. You can touch her if you reach out your hand now.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: What do you want to do to me? Use your "<color=#fb9259>shackles</color>"?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Come on, try me. Let's see if you're fast enough to subdue me before I break off your arm.
This is a real threat. You can't risk it and raise your hand, but you can't back down like this either. The two of you are locked in a stalemate, neither is taking action.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...You're still resisting even now. You seem very confident in your own power.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: But it's time to face the truth. You're in my territory now. If I run electricity through this chair, you'll soon breathe your last breath.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I know you have the ability to control Sinners. Tell me about its effects, how to activate it, how to remove it, and the side effects.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I need to know everything about the shackles.
This is her true purpose.

options: I'm sorry, but I don't know everything
If I refuse to talk, are you gonna kill me?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Stop wasting my time.

steps.speaker: Ringtone
steps.content: Bzzzz...
She keeps looking down at you, locking her gaze on you. The call gets picked up automatically.

steps.speaker: Telephone
steps.content: Commander, we've got some answers here.

steps.speaker: Telephone
steps.content: It's a special case. The MBCC probably hasn't completely figured out how the shackles work either.

steps.speaker: Telephone
steps.content: Currently, they mainly control Sinners with these three features of the Shackles: <color=#fb9259>combat ability enhancement</color>, <color=#fb9259>weak sense tracking</color>, and the <color=#fb9259>Forbidden Force</color>.

steps.speaker: Telephone
steps.content: Once the shackles are established, the enabler can sense the shackled Sinner's location and absolutely forbid specific behaviors in the Sinner with clearly worded orders.

steps.speaker: Telephone
steps.content: The shackles must be established through direct physical contact. The removal condition is the death of either the enabler or the shackled Sinner.
Zoya is observing your expression as she's listening, as if trying to confirm what she's hearing.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: That's why those geezers picked him... He surely makes a good slave.
steps.female_content: That's why those geezers picked her... She surely makes a good slave.

steps.speaker: Telephone
steps.content: Also, that other thing you're concerned about, it's confirmed too.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Go on.

steps.speaker: Telephone
steps.content: Mania intensification will stop completely in a shackled Sinner. Not even contact with contamination will result in corruption.

steps.speaker: Telephone
steps.content: This man can suppress Mania.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Wrap up the interrogation, Earl. Once we arrive, bring the two Sinners to me.
She straightens up. There seems to be no more need to ask you anything.

options: Did Iron from SALVA tell you that?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Ha... She's not gonna talk. She despises me more than lapdogs like you.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: It's a <color=#fb9259>separate interrogation</color>, the authorities' expertise. The Legion's got other vehicles. My subordinates are interrogating the others there. He did a good job.

options: What did you do to them?!
What exactly do you want from me?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Hmm... I see, this is your first reaction.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: If you've got such little trust in your subordinates, don't expect loyalty from them.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Hmm, that's rather unexpected. Didn't think you'd care so much about them.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Relax, you'll get to see them soon.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I've told you already, I need your help.
The truck has stopped in the desert on the outskirts of the city. You're taken out from the container and forced to walk on the white sand to a cliff, under which lies a huge crypt.
And from somewhere deeper than the crypt, waves of something even more viscous and evil are crashing.

options: Where are we? What's down there?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Oh? You can feel it? I knew I was right to bring you here.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: My subordinates have come here after leaving SALVA. This is where the inheritance lies.
